BRR-Fay replicate covariance \(\hat\beta_m\) $$U_m = \frac{1}{R(1 - k)^2} \sum_{r=1}^{R}   (\hat\beta_m^{(r)} - \hat\beta_m)(\hat\beta_m^{(r)} - \hat\beta_m)^\top,$$ \(k\) Fay coefficient fay_k. replicate, Fay's method multiplies weights one half-sample \(2 - k\) \(k\), plain BRR uses 2 0; factor \(1/(1 - k)^2\) corrects variance smaller change weights (Judkins 1990).
